evidence_type: LIVE (real D2 workload: per-response pacing + tc/netem + real downloader policies; aria2 reference)

workload.per_response_pacing: rate sampled at request start and held for the whole response
workload.content_verification: full SHA-256 + byte-exact check against the logical generator
workload.measurement: completion_ms = wall clock from before the download call to after it returns (same definition as the frozen benchmark)

fixed.note: the frozen best fixed configuration from the competitive benchmark

aria2.purpose: environment consistency checks only (not part of the blocked matrix)

frozen_controller_configuration.chunk_admissible_set_note: starting at 4 MiB with +/- 1 MiB steps clamped to [256 KiB, 16 MiB]: the reachable values are exactly {256 KiB} union {1..16 MiB}
frozen_controller_configuration.decision_cadence: one serialized policy decision per completed attempt (the existing policyRunner path)
frozen_controller_configuration.policy_signal: ctx.Throughput = windowed PER-REQUEST throughput (bytes / request durations over the last 4 attempts)
frozen_controller_configuration.retry_semantics: same-range retry with original boundaries, max 3 attempts (MaxRetries=3), then the download fails

policy_rules.throughput_policy: compare ctx.Throughput with the previous decision: relative change >= +10% -> increase concurrency (if < max); <= -10% -> decrease (if > min); else no change; first decision is a no-op baseline
policy_rules.chunk_policy: same relative rule applied to chunk size (step +/- 1 MiB, clamped)
policy_rules.joint_policy: same relative rule; on each actionable decision, acts on the preferred dimension (concurrency first, alternating after each applied action), falling back to the other dimension at a bound

experimental_design.aria2_consistency_note: three fresh aria2 runs with the frozen flags, outside the blocked matrix, to check cross-session environment consistency against the immutable 30-pair reference

primary_comparisons.A: joint adaptive vs the best fixed configuration in this study (fixed mode, N=16/S=4 MiB), paired per block
primary_comparisons.B: joint adaptive vs the frozen aria2 configuration: joint runs vs the immutable 30-pair aria2 distribution from testdata/aria2_competitive_benchmark/final_reproduction/pairs.json (unpaired geometric ratio + bootstrap CI); the three fresh aria2 consistency runs are reported separately
primary_comparisons.note: beating aria2 alone is not evidence that adaptation added value; comparison A is the adaptation-value test

statistics.paired_ratios: per-block ratio joint/fixed; geometric mean over blocks
statistics.confidence_interval: 95% bootstrap percentile CI (10000 resamples) on the geometric mean ratio
statistics.beats_rule: mode X beats mode Y iff geometric ratio(X/Y) <= 0.95 (>= 5% faster) AND the 95% CI upper bound < 1.0
statistics.aria2_ratio: geometric mean(joint completions) / geometric mean(frozen aria2 30 completions) with a bootstrap CI over both samples

adaptation_evidence.joint_adaptation_demonstrated: at least 50% of valid joint runs changed BOTH N and S at least once; otherwise classification E
adaptation_evidence.alignment_check: whether N/S changes align with the observed D2 pacing phases (request rate transitions at 2 s and 4 s)

classification_rules.A: BEATS_FIXED_AND_ARIA2: joint beats fixed (rule above) and beats aria2 (rule above)
classification_rules.B: BEATS_FIXED_ONLY: joint beats fixed but not aria2
classification_rules.C: BEATS_ARIA2_ONLY: joint beats aria2 but not fixed
classification_rules.D: NO_CLEAR_ADAPTIVE_GAIN: neither comparison meets the beats rule
classification_rules.E: NOT_DEMONSTRATED: joint adaptation not demonstrated (fewer than 50% of valid joint runs changed both N and S); overrides A-D

infrastructure.memory: logical server; worst-case in-flight response buffers 16 x 16 MiB = 256 MiB; container available memory ~690 MiB
